5×7 oversized [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] held next to the regular-size [[Enhanced Jabba's Palace]] original. Still at 4:56 of ''Guide - SW:CCG Collection - Oversized/Undersized Cards''.

Fair use of a video still for identification of the physical 5×7 show premium on [[Oversized and undersized cards|Oversized cards]], [[Shannon Baksa]], and [[Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood]]. Source: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=frvqLMqMc14 The CCG Collector] (29 November 2015). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-frvqLMqMc14 Internet Archive].
